cues.zh: 你闻不到的这东西，叫作西毒粉。
cues.en: What you do not smell is called iocane powder.

cues.zh: 它无色无味，入水即溶，是人类已知最致命的毒药之一。
cues.en: It is odorless, tasteless, dissolves instantly in liquid, and is among the more deadly poisons known to man.

cues.zh: 好吧。
cues.en: All right.

cues.zh: 毒下在哪了？
cues.en: Where is the poison?

cues.zh: 智力对决已经开始，你做决定，我们各自喝下，看谁猜对，看谁丧命，就算结束？
cues.en: The battle of wits has begun. It ends when you decide and we both drink, and find out who is right and who is dead?

cues.zh: 但这太简单了。
cues.en: But it's so simple.

cues.zh: 我只需根据对你的了解来推测。
cues.en: All I have to do is divine from what I know of you.

cues.zh: 你是那种会把毒下在自己杯里的人，还是敌人的杯里？
cues.en: Are you the sort of man who would put the poison into his own goblet or his enemy's?

cues.zh: 聪明人会把毒下在自己杯里，
cues.en: Now a clever man would put the poison into his own goblet

cues.zh: 因为他知道，只有大傻子才会直接喝别人给他的酒。
cues.en: Because he would know that only a great fool would reach for what he was given.

cues.zh: 我可不是大傻子，所以我显然不能选你面前的那杯酒。
cues.en: I'm not a great fool so I can clearly not choose the wine in front of you

cues.zh: 但你肯定知道我不是大傻子，
cues.en: But you must have known I was not a great fool

cues.zh: 你也早料到了这点，所以我显然也不能选我面前的这杯酒。
cues.en: You would have counted on it so I can clearly not choose the wine in front of me

cues.zh: 那你已经做决定了。
cues.en: You've made your decision then.

cues.zh: 绝不可能，因为人人都知道，Iocane毒药产自澳大利亚，而澳大利亚全都是罪犯，
cues.en: Not remotely because iocane comes from Australia as everyone knows and Australia is entirely people with criminals and

cues.zh: 罪犯习惯了不被别人信任，就像我不信任你一样，所以我显然不能选你面前的酒。
cues.en: Criminals are used to having people not trust them as you are not trusted by me so I could clearly not choose the wine in front of you.

cues.zh: 你的才智真是让人眼花缭乱。
cues.en: Truly you have a dizzying intellect

cues.zh: 等我火力全开的时候再说吧！
cues.en: Wait till I get going

cues.zh: 我刚才说到哪儿了？
cues.en: Where was I?

cues.zh: 澳大利亚，对，澳大利亚。
cues.en: Australia, yes, Australia

cues.zh: 你肯定猜到我能认出这粉末的来历，所以我显然不能选我面前的酒。
cues.en: And you must have suspected I would have known the powder's origin so I can clearly not choose the wine in front of me

cues.zh: 你现在只是在拖延时间。
cues.en: You're just stalling now.

cues.zh: 你想得美！是不是？
cues.en: You'd like to think that! Wouldn't you?

cues.zh: 你打败了我的巨人，说明你力大无穷，
cues.en: You've beaten my giant which means you're exceptionally strong

cues.zh: 所以你完全可能把毒药下在自己的酒杯里，指望靠体格硬抗，
cues.en: so you could have put the poison in your own goblet trusting on your strength to save you

cues.zh: 所以我显然不能选你面前的酒。
cues.en: so I can clearly not choose the wine in front of you

cues.zh: 但你也击败了我的西班牙高手，说明你一定学识渊博，
cues.en: But you've also bested my Spaniard, which means you must have studied

cues.zh: 而在求学中，你肯定明白凡人皆有一死，
cues.en: and in studying you must have learned that man is mortal

cues.zh: 所以你会把毒药放得离自己越远越好，
cues.en: so you would have put the poison as far from yourself as possible,

cues.zh: 所以我显然不能选我面前的酒。
cues.en: so I can clearly not choose the wine in front of me

cues.zh: 你想套我的话。没用的。
cues.en: You're trying to trick me into giving away something. It won't work.

cues.zh: 成功了！你把一切都暴露了！
cues.en: It has worked! You've given everything away!

cues.zh: 我知道毒药在哪里！
cues.en: I know where the poison is!

cues.zh: 那就做选择吧。我来选，我选——那到底是什么东西？
cues.en: Then make your choice. I will and I choose- what in the world can that be?

cues.zh: 什么？哪里
cues.en: What? Where

cues.zh: 我什么都没看见。
cues.en: I don't see anything.

cues.zh: 我发誓我看到了什么。我以为——算了
cues.en: I could have sworn I saw something. I thought- no matter

cues.zh: 有什么好笑的？
cues.en: What's so funny?

cues.zh: 我一会儿告诉你
cues.en: I'll tell you in a minute

cues.zh: 先喝一杯吧，我喝我的杯子，你喝你的
cues.en: First let's drink, me from my glass and you from yours

cues.zh: 你猜错了。
cues.en: You guessed wrong.

cues.zh: 你只是以为我猜错了。这才是好笑的地方！
cues.en: You only think I guessed wrong. That's what's so funny!

cues.zh: 你转身的时候我换了杯子！
cues.en: I switched glasses when your back was turned!

cues.zh: 你这个蠢货！你中了经典的致命错误之一！
cues.en: You fool! You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!

cues.zh: 最著名的一条是：永远别卷入亚洲的地面战争
cues.en: The most famous is never get involved in a land war in Asia

cues.zh: 但稍微没那么出名的一条是：生死关头，永远别跟西西里人作对！
cues.en: But only slightly less well-known is this: never go in against a Sicilian when death is on the line!

cues.zh: 你是谁？
cues.en: Who are you?

cues.zh: 我可不是好惹的。你只需要知道这些就够了
cues.en: I'm no one to be trifled with. That is all you ever need know

cues.zh: 想想吧，一直以来有毒的都是你的杯子。
cues.en: To think all that time it was your cup that was poisoned.

cues.zh: 他们俩都中毒了。
cues.en: They were both poisoned.

cues.zh: 我花了几年时间，培养出了对艾欧凯恩粉末的免疫力。
cues.en: I spent the last few years building up an immunity to iocane powder.
